name: Highlighter
concept: Keep the page desaturated so a single chartreuse stroke reads as emphasis rather than decoration.

type.families: Geometric sans with tight tracking (Space Grotesk, General Sans, Aeonik). Headlines set negative at -0.03em.
type.hierarchy: Hero numeral 64/64 light or 72/72 · section 24/30 medium · body 14/21 regular · micro-caps 10/12 medium ALL-CAPS 0.1em. Oversized light-weight numerals are the signature — a metric should be able to fill a third of a card.
type.usage: Let one huge numeral carry the hierarchy per card. Chartreuse never sets type — it sits *behind* type as a highlighter swipe, or fills a pill whose label is `--accent_ink`.

tokens.texture: Flat, with one behaviour that defines the style: chartreuse is applied like a marker, not a fill. Use it as a short swipe behind a word (a skewed rectangle at 0 opacity change), as an underline 6px thick sitting behind the baseline, or as a solid pill. Solid charcoal `--block` cards provide the counterweight. No gradients, no glow — the acid does all the shouting.
tokens.layout: Moderate density with strong blocking. 8px scale, 20-24px card padding, 12-16px radius, occasional pill (999px). Cards alternate between white and solid `--block`. Folder-tab navigation — tabs that visually attach to the panel below — is the characteristic nav pattern. Charts render as open thin-arc gauges rather than filled donuts.

best_for: products targeting a younger technical audience
avoid_for: accessibility-critical products where the accent would be relied on for meaning

image_recipe.template:
[SUBJECT: describe the subject in one clause — e.g. "a stack of shipping containers", "a single ceramic cup", "an abstract network of nodes"]

Rendered as flat vector illustration or matte 3D render with a single fluorescent accent.

STYLE — apply all of the following, they are not optional:
- desaturated warm-grey ground #EDEFEA
- exactly one fluorescent chartreuse #C3EC2E used on no more than 10% of the frame
- solid near-black #1C1E18 masses as counterweight
- matte surfaces, flat or very soft lighting
- geometric shapes with generous rounding

NEGATIVE SPACE: Keep the right 30% as empty desaturated ground for type.

DO NOT INCLUDE: multiple bright colours, pastel palettes, glossy or metallic surfaces, photographic realism, gradients, neon glow.
image_recipe.provider: configurable — set to your image provider
image_recipe.model: configurable — set to your image model
image_recipe.resolution: 1536x1024 (3:2 landscape); use 1024x1536 for portrait, 1024x1024 for square
hard_constraints: exactly one fluorescent chartreuse #C3EC2E used on no more than 10% of the frame
matte surfaces, flat or very soft lighting
negative space — Keep the right 30% as empty desaturated ground for type.
never include legible text, logos or UI chrome in the generated image
